Major US Banks Report Strong Quarterly Profits

JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs have reported significant increases in their quarterly profits. Goldman Sachs exceeded profit estimates, driven by strength in its equities division. JPMorgan Chase also saw its profits jump. These strong earnings from major banks are providing support to the Wall Street market, even as chip stocks experience a decline.
